style.backgroundSystem: three locked fields and nothing else: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the on-body packshot and the variant row, pale mist-grey #EFF1F4 for the callout, detail grid and trust screens, and one coastal field of sand #DCC7A8, sea #6E9CB4 and sky #A9C7DC for the two outdoor screens; the single macro screen uses the garment own surface #17181B
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line glyphs in deep charcoal #2E3238 inside square outlined frames on the pale field #EFF1F4, one abstract glyph per frame, identical stroke weight and frame size, label slots left empty; never a seal, ribbon, award or certification pictogram
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced studio key at 5600K from the front-left with a white bounce on the shadow side, low contrast, matte fabric read with no hard specular, one honest soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment; outdoor screens keep hard high sun from the upper left or upper right at 5800-6000K with a matching single shadow direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean active womens outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, pale mist-grey #EFF1F4, coastal sky blue #A9C7DC and one warm sun gold accent #E8A33D; daylight-balanced studio key at 5600K from the front-left with white bounce fill, low contrast, matte fabric read and one honest soft contact shadow grounding the garment, outdoor screens on hard high sun with a single matching shadow direction; one modern geometric sans-serif family in deep charcoal #2E3238 with thin single-weight leader rules as the label system; single-weight thin line glyphs inside square outlined frames with empty label slots; worn view cropped from the jaw down plus close crops on hands, collar, cuff and fabric as the only product scales; stable garment scale and hem position; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no visible model face or identifiable person
no invented ratings, measurements, percentages or seals
style.presentationRules: two locked scales only: the worn view cropped from the jaw down so no face ever enters frame, and the close crop on hands, collar, cuff and fabric; garment scale, hem position and closure line stay identical between screens; every panel of a multi-panel screen reuses the exact same light and crop; pocket, seam and hardware placement is always read from the reference and never redrawn
style.surfaceSystem: matte white painted cyclorama #FFFFFF, matte pale grey board #EFF1F4 for laid and folded screens, bare sand #DCC7A8 outdoors; no wood, no marble, no glossy acrylic plinth
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, medium weight for headline lines in deep charcoal #2E3238, small letterspaced caps for micro labels, thin single-weight leader rules as the whole label system; no serif, no script, no retro or cartoon faces
